differencesAndCorrections.expected: a coordinate-level CDP click will carry WebView fullscreen user activation
differencesAndCorrections.actual: the first real run timed out because the synthetic coordinate event did not grant the Fullscreen API activation
differencesAndCorrections.correction: the harness now invokes the same real button through CDP Runtime.evaluate with userGesture=true; product behavior was not bypassed

differencesAndCorrections.expected: the dynamic native title remains the button accessible name
differencesAndCorrections.actual: the application tooltip layer intentionally removes native title attributes, leaving the audit's accessible-name field empty
differencesAndCorrections.correction: the product now supplies a dynamic aria-label for enter and exit states

differencesAndCorrections.expected: route-unmount exitFullscreen completes without an error
differencesAndCorrections.actual: WebView deactivated the Document before the unmount promise resolved, producing a rejected Document-not-active runtime error
differencesAndCorrections.correction: unmount cleanup now handles the bounded rejection while the browser clears fullscreen; final fullscreenElement=null remains mandatory
